Can you scan while the plant is operating?
Usually, yes. Laser scanning is non-contact, so most areas can be captured while the facility runs, subject to your site permits, safety rules and access.
How accurate is 3D laser scanning?

Accuracy depends on the scanner, range, surface and registration. The accuracy the project needs is agreed in the scan plan and reported in the registration report — we don't quote one figure for every site.
Which file formats will I receive?
Point clouds are typically delivered as E57 (an open format) and RCP / RCS for Autodesk software, with DWG extracts where needed. Formats are agreed in the scope.
What is the difference between a point cloud and a model?
A point cloud is the raw measured record — millions of points. A model or drawing is built from it: as-built drawings, a BIM model or CAD solids. One scan can produce several of these.

A mesh (such as STL) is a surface of triangles — good for visualising or 3D printing but hard to edit. A parametric model is built from features and dimensions, so it can be changed and used for manufacturing drawings.
Can you reproduce a worn or damaged part?
Yes. Where a part is worn, we agree with you how to recover the original design intent rather than copying the wear.
Which formats will I receive?
Typically STEP and IGES for the CAD solid, STL for the mesh, and DWG / PDF for drawings. Native formats can be agreed in the scope.
Do you manufacture the replacement part?
The deliverable is the CAD model, drawings and deviation report. Manufacturing can be arranged separately as your project requires.

What is the difference between FRP and GRP tanks?
They describe the same family of material — a resin laminate reinforced with glass fiber. FRP (fiber-reinforced plastic) and GRP (glass-reinforced plastic) are used interchangeably.
Can FRP tanks store chemicals?

Yes. FRP is widely used for chemical storage because the resin system can be selected for the specific chemical, concentration and temperature. Share those details and our engineers confirm the suitable construction before fabrication.
Can an FRP tank be installed underground?
Yes. Underground FRP tanks are supported by foundation, anchoring and installation details in the design package, with the design accounting for soil and external loads.
